findings.title: An immutable pre-capture Q becomes stale when first durable producer or repair artifact capture increments task version
findings.trigger: A new Q is recorded at current task version V, then the required sequence performs first captureNormalNativeResult or writeNormalNativeRepairArtifact, then attempts finishNormalNativeExecution with that same Q.
sourceProof: recordOwnerNativeFinishIntent admits first Q through #ownerFinishActive -> original #cas, so expectedTaskVersion must equal actual V; intent write does not increment it.

captureNormalNativeResult uses the original #artifactEffect. writeNormalNativeRepairArtifact uses the same helper. The helper unconditionally calls #update, which increments actual task version to V+1.
finishNormalNativeExecution first requires the authentic immutable same-Q intent, then original #cas compares actual V+1 to Q.expectedTaskVersion V and throws STALE_VERSION before settlement.

Changing Q for the same eventual command conflicts in #ownerFinishIntent. Recording a fresh post-capture command is a distinct intent and cannot establish the companion's promised pre-capture ordering for that new exact Q.
findings.scope: This is confirmed for first durable producer output/artifact capture and repair artifact writes after Q. It does not assert failure for an already durably captured artifact/output or for a read-only collector of such a capture. No separate runtime composition has been reviewed or executed here. Stop/normal stopped observation does not increment task version at original workerObservation880-907; unknown observation does, and must still cause currentness denial.
findings.impact: The prescribed first-capture sequence cannot finish the same immutable owner command even without races, quota pressure, storage faults or foreign inputs. The intent remains pending and the reservation cannot be released by this attempted finish. This is distinct from later authorized traffic consuming admission headroom.
findings.remediation: Root must request a fresh bounded literal/source amendment. Root has proposed requiring durable output/artifact/report capture before owner Q, then persisting exact Q before stop, current read-only collector, actual-usage reread and final finish. This steering is not reviewed implementation. It must preserve exact immutable Q, original task/auth CAS, scope/current-source/lifetime guards, and no refresh/backfill/replay authority. Explicitly prove which post-Q operations may change task version; unknown/error transitions must fail closed. Re-freeze the companion/runtime source and obtain fresh affected review before adoption.
